title: Brown's task force captures Miethe

tellings.quote: Miethe is the mysterious high-voltage physicist that Townsend Brown's task force reportedly helped capture for the Allied forces.

plain: In Germany in 1945, a task force that the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown was part of reportedly helped capture Richard Miethe for the Allied forces. Michels describes Miethe as a mysterious high-voltage physicist and tells this himself, without naming a source. If true, it would tie Brown to wartime German research on high-voltage technology.
